I study how children and adolescents regulate emotion within family and peer
systems, and how moment-to-moment regulatory dynamics become longer-term
patterns of adaptation and physiological health.

My work pairs physiological measurement (respiratory sinus arrhythmia, dyadic
synchrony, ambulatory heart-rate variability) with intensive longitudinal
designs such as 14-day diaries and experience sampling. Methodologically I work
in within-person dynamics, person-centred models, and network approaches, mostly
in **R** and **Mplus**.

I work with [Aprile Benner](https://liberalarts.utexas.edu/hdfs/) at UT Austin.
Before this I earned an M.A. in Human Development and Family Sciences at UT
Austin, and an M.A. in Developmental Psychology and a B.S. in Psychology at
Beijing Normal University.

I also teach research methods, both as instructor of record and as a teaching
assistant across our undergraduate and graduate sequences, and I run an
[annual R workshop](teaching.qmd) for graduate students in my department.

## Recent highlights

::: {.highlights}
- [Jun 2026]{.when} Presented a poster at the ISSBD Biennial Meeting in Incheon, South Korea, on how emotion dynamics link academic adversity to adolescent internalizing symptoms
- [Jun 2026]{.when} Our paper on assessing preschoolers' emotion regulation across home, school, and the lab came out in *Early Childhood Research Quarterly*
- [Apr 2026]{.when} My paper on emotion polyregulation in preschoolers was published in *Child Development*
- [Apr 2026]{.when} Presented at the SRA Biennial Meeting in Toronto on racial and ethnic discrimination and adolescents' emotional dynamics
- [Jan 2026]{.when} Ran our department's graduate statistics workshop on using AI assistants for data analysis
- [Fall 2025]{.when} Received the Outstanding Graduate Research Fellowship from the UT Austin Graduate School for 2026 to 2027
- [Fall 2025]{.when} Taught my first course as instructor of record, HDF 315L Research Methods
- [Aug 2025]{.when} Finished my M.A. at UT Austin, on emotion polyregulation in preschoolers
:::
